specimens.name: Slotted wiring-duct segment with routed harness
specimens.notes: Short gray slotted wiring duct contains a neatly routed multicolor harness under a snap-on lid edge; remains a local fragment only.

specimens.name: Braided multi-core harness branch with heat-shrink breakout
specimens.notes: Braided harness splits into three controlled branches through molded breakout sleeves and repeated strain-relief clamps; no labels or uncontrolled loose wiring.

specimens.name: Shielded coaxial diagnostic cable segment
specimens.notes: Single short shielded test cable has matching metal bayonet/coax connectors at both ends and molded strain reliefs; no instrument or panel.

specimens.name: Circular multipin bayonet connector pair with short tails
specimens.notes: Matching circular multipin plug/receptacle pair uses knurled locking shells and very short organized harness tails; no equipment panel or labels.

specimens.name: Grouped sealed cable-gland bulkhead pass-through
specimens.notes: Small bulkhead plate shows exactly four identical sealed glands in an even pattern with short cable stubs; no full enclosure or wall.

specimens.name: Stainless instrumentation-tubing elbow and compression union
specimens.notes: Short clean stainless tube fragment has one precise 90-degree bend and a compression-union assembly without valves, gauges or surrounding network.

specimens.name: Crimped service hose with quick-disconnect coupling
specimens.notes: Short reinforced hose has a factory-crimped ferrule and one compact quick-disconnect coupling; no manifold or complete hydraulic system.

specimens.name: Compact solenoid manifold with dedicated diagnostic/test ports
specimens.notes: Compact machined manifold block has two solenoid coil housings, standardized ports and two capped diagnostic/test ports with no hoses, wires, gauges or cabinet.

review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 machine spec, style bible and E2 era contract; local SHA-256, dimensions and byte count verified; Google Drive upload metadata confirms the same exact byte count and destination before acceptance.
